decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - (5)	The proposed replacement rear access route shall be provided prior to commencement of the development hereby approved, and rear access to No 8 from the car park to the west shall be retained at all times

Condition : 6 - It is considered that the single storey rear extension would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of number 7 War Memorial Homes, Chiswick and surrounding dwellings and will preserve the character of the Chiswick House Conservation Area.  The proposal is not considered to be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties.  Any departures are justified due to the special circumstances of the applicant and of the nature of the dwellings, and, on balance, the development is considered to comply with the UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Alterations and Extensions) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to provide a bedroom to house.
